title_pt: Seis tartarugas-cabeçudas retiradas de venda no Mercado de Obour
title_en: Six loggerhead turtles removed from sale at Obour Market
title_es: Seis tortugas bobas retiradas de la venta en el Mercado de Obour
card_text_pt: Seis tartarugas-cabeçudas ameaçadas foram encontradas expostas para venda e encaminhadas ao centro de resgate de tartarugas marinhas da Reserva Ashtum El-Gamil.
card_text_en: Six threatened loggerhead turtles were found offered for sale and transferred to the sea-turtle rescue centre at Ashtum El-Gamil Reserve.
card_text_es: Seis tortugas bobas amenazadas fueron encontradas a la venta y trasladadas al centro de rescate de tortugas marinas de la Reserva Ashtum El-Gamil.
